checkpoints.description: [1/6] Build lattice v0.1.0: SQLite knowledge graph (papers, claims, questions, typed edges, provenance), BibTeX/RIS/CSV/Markdown ingest with dedupe, ask/brief/review, check gate and MCP stdio server. Milestones: core store+CLI; ingest; claims/edges; ask/brief; review; MCP+gate+docs.

impact_assessment.why: User approved a provenance-first research knowledge base for agents; the workspace has no such project.
impact_assessment.benefits: Agents get a deterministic, citation-checked evidence graph with a stable JSON/MCP API; humans get literature-review tooling.
impact_assessment.risks: Scope creep in parsing and entity resolution; schema churn; LLM coupling; PDF extraction.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Text formats and explicit dedupe first, SQLite schema versioned with migrations, deterministic core with agents as clients, PDFs out of scope; tests per milestone.

checkpoints.description: [6/6] Completed lattice v0.1.0: SQLite graph, ingest, claims/edges, ask/brief/review, integrity checks, MCP stdio server, 65 unit tests, ADRs and docs; checklists: passed

[1/5] Plan lattice v0.2.0: (1) pluggable literature discovery (arXiv, Crossref, offline corpus), (2) automated claim & edge extraction from papers, (3) ranked search, multi-hop subgraph & atomic JSONL snapshots, (4) scientific literature synthesis engine with consensus scoring, (5) CLI + MCP tools/resources/prompts + ADRs + docs.

impact_assessment.why: User requested automated literature search, knowledge creation, knowledge interaction, and literature synthesis for scientific queries so AI agents can easily obtain structured evidence.
impact_assessment.benefits: Agents and researchers can discover papers, extract quote-backed claims automatically, traverse multi-hop subgraphs, export/import snapshots, and generate consensus-scored scientific syntheses via CLI and MCP.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: existing CLI/MCP payloads must remain backward-compatible; dependency: stdlib-only constraint for HTTP/XML/JSON; concurrency: network timeouts and atomic snapshot writes; state: idempotent extraction and snapshot merge.
impact_assessment.mitigation: 4-layer pluggable discovery with 10s urllib timeout and offline provider for unit tests; deterministic sentence/quote extraction; atomic temp+fsync+replace snapshot export; backward-compatible search and MCP schemas.
